title: Real worker actor lifecycle accepted for OBS-02
summary: A real OpenCode 1.14.48 / Qwen3.8 / llama.cpp worker demonstrated truthful TERM→OC→QWEN→LLAMA activity and terminal lifecycle on one correlation, including failure-path closure and idle-after-terminal behavior.
claims: During live inference TERM, OC, QWEN and LLAMA were RUNNING on correlation corr:30b0bf97-d535-4f6b-a41a-43f9df816d01.
The failure path closed TERM, OC, QWEN and LLAMA as ERROR on the same correlation.
After termination all actor activity flags returned false.
The Side Panel visually showed Last task, zero open spans, and terminal LLAMA/QWEN/OC/TERM spans.
decision: Close OBS-02 actor activity/lifecycle truth at 100%; continue causal-provenance work under OBS-04/GW-01.
rationale: The remaining deficiencies concern correlation propagation and trace UX rather than actor activity truth.

evidence.note: Allowed artifact created by the real worker.
